svg.aria-label: The heart of Mission 2, planned and flown flat at 50 m, photographed from below with a long exposure. The flown heart is about 0.6 metres off the plan on average, 2 metres at most; the left lobe is too big and the notch too low.
svg.text: Flat at 50 m, 7 Nov 2026. Off the plan: mean 0.6 m, max 2.0 m
